title: PoroMechanics.jl: Reactive transport and poromechanics of porous media
description: Simulation of coupled phenomena in porous media: unsaturated flow (Richards, Darcy), solute diffusion, non-isothermal drying coupling liquid water, dry air and heat, Biot poroelasticity, and multi-ionic reactive transport in cementitious materials with thermodynamic equilibrium from cemdata18. Physics models are declared as plain structs implementing a small callback interface, on two numerical backends: finite volumes (VoronoiFVM.jl) for transport, finite elements (Ferrite.jl) for coupled mechanics. Jacobians are obtained by automatic differentiation rather than written by hand.
